narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Eight thousand five hundred and sixty is not divisible by ten because its tens digit is six.
<bookmark mark='bunch'/>But six tens are six full bunches, and every bunch has exactly ten bananas.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The tens digit never leaves loose bananas, so it cannot stop ten dividing.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says 8560 is not divisible by ten because its tens digit is six; the 6 tens are regrouped into bunches and nothing is left; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Make bunches of ten, and then look at how many loose ones are left over.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Is six thousand nine hundred and five divisible by ten? Say why.
